name: o7574

schema.title: Configuration
schema.description: Schema for proxy server configuration file (and for config passed to proxy middleware)

services.title: proxied services
services.description: each property name will be an executor exposed to JSONScript interpreter

Promise.description: Promise class to use, will be ignored if used from command line

processResponse.description: defines how response from service is processed

anyOf.description: return only response body if status code is < 300, throw an exception otherwise
uses custom keyword 'typeof', function should return result or throw exception

description:
Hi team,

The current proxy configuration defines two services that will be available to the JSONScript interpreter. The service named **myService** points to `https://api.example.com/v1/` and is configured to return only the response body (i.e., it uses the “body” processing rule). The second service, **anotherService**, is mapped to `https://service.example.org/api` and will use the default response handling. 

For the interpreter itself, we are running in **strict mode** with a **maximum stack depth of 1,000**. In addition, the overall response‑processing strategy for the proxy is set to the same “body” rule, meaning only successful response bodies (status < 300) will be returned.
